title: catalogue.correspondences
description: catalogue/context/correspondences.json: the correspondences well — the assembled matrix that reads each of the 11 cards (F..L8) through each of the 14 academic-practice pathways, grounding every reading in FHEQ/CQFW statement ids and placing conceptual models, professional frameworks, qualification frameworks, cross-cutting themes and the 54 subject benchmarks against the same card grid. Extracted from the rendered Pathway Table of Correspondences (docs/curriculum/pathway-table-of-correspondences.html) by tools/extract-correspondences.py; a generator renders that HTML back FROM this store. Concept-ordered: provenance (version/built/source), then the reading dimensions (meta), the pathway strands (pathways), the theme lenses (themes), the subject benchmarks (benchmarks), and the card grid itself (rows). DUAL AXES: meta[0]/meta[1] are Tier and Indicative level, and every row.meta carries both; the tier<->level relationship is the card grid itself, stated once here. Deep nested reading content is intentionally permissive so nothing useful is lost.

correspondencesVersion.description: Semver of this store's shape; bump on any shape change.

built.description: Human date the underlying table was built, carried from the source.

source.description: Provenance pointer to the rendered table this was extracted from.

meta.description: The reading dimensions, in order. meta[0]=Tier and meta[1]=Indicative level are the DUAL AXES carried by every row; meta[2..] are the practice/knowledge/practitioner-identity triad and the metacognitive stance.

pathways.description: The academic-practice pathways, each a strand read down the card grid.

themes.description: The lenses placed against the rows: development models, metacognition models, professional frameworks, qualification frameworks and cross-cutting themes. group partitions them; run is the citation; subs are sub-series where a lens has them.

benchmarks.description: The 54 QAA subject benchmarks, read the same three ways where the benchmark speaks. subjectIds are grounding pointers into the standards runs.

rows.description: The card grid, foundation to level 8. Each row is one card position. row.meta gives the generic (pathway-independent) reading across the meta dimensions; row.cells is keyed by pathway number ('1'..'14') and holds that card read through each pathway strand (capability, kind-of-knowledge, FHEQ statement ids, then the practice / knowledge / practitioner-identity readings with their FHEQ descriptors); row.themes is keyed by theme key; row.bm is keyed by benchmark slug.

row.description: Card position label (F, i1..i3, d1..d3, e1..e3, L8).

meta.description: The generic reading across the meta dimensions; meta[0] Tier and meta[1] Indicative level are the dual axes for this card.

cells.description: Keyed by pathway number as a string; each value is the card read through that pathway strand (an array of reading parts).
